program.name: certified_neighborhood_completion
program.rationale: Prioritize vertices whose weight dominates a clique-cover upper bound on their active neighborhood's independent alternatives, then rank the remaining vertices by normalized residual completion with restrained cover optimism, competing-neighbor opportunity cost, and boundary relief.

program.name: Certified neighborhood exchange
program.rationale: Prioritize vertices whose weight covers a clique-cover upper bound on their active neighbors, then extend the warm seed's residual completion forecast with capped optimism, neighbor opportunity cost, and bounded boundary relief.

program.name: simplicial_guarded_conflict_compression
program.rule: 2 + weight/max(1e-9,weight+active_neighbor_mass) if active_neighbor_count == 0 or (2*active_neighbor_edges == active_neighbor_count*(active_neighbor_count-1) and weight >= active_neighbor_peak) else weight/max(1e-9,weight+max(active_neighbor_peak,active_neighbor_mass*active_neighbor_mass/max(1e-9,active_neighbor_mass+2*active_neighbor_overlap)))
program.rationale: Use a guarded local ratio instead of additive residual lookahead. Isolated vertices and weight-dominant vertices with clique neighborhoods receive first priority because selecting them preserves an optimal completion. Otherwise, compare root weight with an estimate of effective competing weight: conflicts among neighbors compress their total mass, while the heaviest neighbor provides a conservative floor. Only active neighborhood aggregates are required; no residual packing or clique-cover computation is used.

program.name: certified_counterfactual_regret
program.rule: (3 if degree == 0 else (2 + (weight + residual_pack - leaveout_cover)/max(1e-9,weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) if weight + residual_pack >= leaveout_cover else (0.85*(weight + residual_pack - leaveout_pack) + 0.15*(weight + residual_cover - leaveout_cover))/max(1e-9,weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight))) + 0.08*weight/max(1e-9,weight + neighbor_pack) + 0.04*boundary_edges/max(1,degree*max(1,remaining_count-degree-1))
program.rationale: The parents are identical: their common backbone combines root weight, residual greedy packing and clique-cover estimates, neighborhood opportunity cost, and boundary relief. I retain that partition but explore counterfactual regret by comparing forced-root completion with completion after excluding only the root. Isolated roots receive priority, and a forced feasible completion reaching the root-excluded cover bound receives a certificate bonus. Otherwise, normalized completion differences emphasize feasible greedy value over optimistic cover value. Small neighborhood-efficiency and boundary-relief terms refine the ranking. All expressions use only the current active graph; the repair mechanism remains unchanged.

program.name: certified_choices_with_pack_dominant_completion
program.rationale: Replace residual edge count with an active-neighborhood clique-cover bound. Prioritize vertices whose weight covers every possible independent neighborhood replacement; among these certified choices, favor larger neighborhood removal. Otherwise emphasize achievable complete-schedule packing over optimistic cover, penalize independently packable alternatives, and use bounded, weight-scaled boundary and neighborhood densities as small structural corrections. All sets derive solely from the current available graph.

program.name: feasible_residual_numeric_retune
program.rationale: Retain all six feature expressions and the parent score structure, changing only seven coefficients. Emphasize feasible residual packing over the optimistic clique-cover bound, increase the cost of sacrificing independent neighbors, reduce the boundary incentive, strengthen neighborhood-clustering credit and the degree penalty, and soften residual-edge penalization. These numerical changes aim to favor attainable continuations and lower-conflict proposals; no evaluation was performed.

program.name: single_completion_pack
program.rationale: Removing the root's neighbors leaves it isolated, allowing one greedy packing to combine its weight with a feasible residual completion. Eliminate the overlapping residual cover, neighbor packing, and repeated residual/boundary edge calculations. Retain a bounded, weight-scaled clustering and degree correction that distinguishes equal completion estimates on unit graphs and scales consistently with weighted instances.

program.name: clique_compressed_opportunity_ratio
program.rationale: The parents are identical: their common backbone combines immediate weight, residual greedy packing and clique-cover continuation, neighbor opportunity cost, and conflict-edge relief. This variant explores a ratio based on compressed neighbor alternatives: mutually conflicting neighbors should cost less than equally heavy independent neighbors. The midpoint of neighbor packing and cover estimates supplies that cost. A normalized feasible continuation supports the ratio, while the residual cover-minus-pack gap penalizes uncertain optimism instead of rewarding it. Boundary density adds a small preference for removing conflicts that constrain surviving vertices. Structural sets are restricted to available vertices. This is an unevaluated heuristic.

program.name: counterfactual_bound_contrast
program.rationale: Contrast forcing a vertex in against excluding it using a three-to-one blend of greedy packing and clique-cover estimates, with small bonuses for low neighbor opportunity cost and dense boundary relief.

program.name: certified_exchange_residual_priority
program.rationale: Use neighborhood clique-cover bounds to certify safe exchanges before ranking other vertices by preserved residual packing, independent-neighbor opportunity cost, and conflict redundancy.

program.name: simplicial_pair_disagreement
program.rule: (2 + weight/max(1e-9,weight+neighbor_weight)) if (weight >= neighbor_peak and 2*neighbor_edge_count == neighbor_count*(neighbor_count-1)) else (weight/max(1e-9,weight+max(neighbor_peak,neighbor_weight-2*neighbor_pair_weight/max(1e-9,neighbor_weight))) + 0.05*weight/max(1e-9,weight+neighbor_weight))
program.rationale: Replace residual packing and covering lookahead with a local pair-disagreement price. Discount neighbor mass by twice its conflicting weight-product sum divided by its total weight, and floor the estimated opportunity cost at the heaviest neighbor. This price equals total neighbor weight for an independent neighborhood and its maximum weight for a clique. Prioritize roots whose available neighbors form a clique and whose weight dominates every neighbor: an optimum can include such a root by a one-vertex exchange. Otherwise use a weight-to-price ratio with a small preference for lower closed-neighborhood mass. Every structural feature uses only available neighbors.

program.name: certified_exchange_boundary_discount
program.rationale: The identical parents share residual packing and covering estimates, neighbor opportunity cost, and boundary structure. This variant prioritizes certified exchanges: a root whose weight reaches the clique-cover bound on its active neighbors can replace any selected independent subset of those neighbors without losing weight. Remaining ranking favors attainable residual reward, penalizes cover-pack uncertainty, and uses boundary edges to discount neighbor cost with diminishing returns instead of adding an unrestricted bonus. Every structural set is restricted to available vertices.

program.name: certified_exchange_rollout_v06m1
program.rule: weight + residual_pack + 0.1*min(weight,max(0,residual_cover-residual_pack)) - 0.12*max(0,neighbor_pack-weight) + 0.12*boundary_edges/max(1,1+degree) - 0.005*weight*degree/max(1,remaining_count) + (2*active_weight if weight >= neighbor_cover else 0)
program.rationale: Prioritize certified exchanges: when root weight reaches the clique-cover upper bound on available neighbors, including root can replace any conflicting independent subset without reducing reward. Otherwise emphasize the feasible root-plus-residual greedy completion, cap residual-cover optimism, and discount independent neighbor alternatives. Weighted boundary relief supplies a secondary preference for removing conflicts that constrain the surviving graph. Replace residual-edge and neighbor-edge features with neighbor-cover certification and an inexpensive active-weight scale.

program.name: residual_feasibility_numeric_rebalance
program.rationale: Preserve all six feature expressions and the scalar rule structure. Shift the residual blend from 0.6/0.4 to 0.85/0.15 to emphasize feasible greedy continuation over optimistic clique cover. Increase the neighborhood packing penalty and degree penalty, soften both edge bonuses, and reduce the residual edge penalty to limit double counting of difficulty already reflected in residual packing. This is an unevaluated numerical-only mutation.

program.name: compact_feasible_rollout
program.rationale: Replace the residual pack/cover mixture with a feasible completion estimate. Remove overlapping edge-density corrections and repeated clique-cover and induced-edge scans, retaining only a modest neighborhood opportunity-cost estimate. Combine root and neighbor removal into one set difference. Both retained signals use available vertices and scale with weights, without family-specific conditions.

program.name: credible_completion_with_coupled_opportunity_cost
program.rationale: The identical parents share an inclusion-lookahead backbone: root reward, residual packing and cover estimates, neighborhood opportunity cost, and edge-structure corrections. This variant treats the residual cover-minus-pack gap as uncertainty to penalize rather than optimistic reward. It estimates blocked neighborhood value using a packing/cover midpoint, then discounts that cost when neighbors strongly conflict with retained vertices, adjusting for residual conflict density. The thought is to favor credible completions while recognizing that blocked alternatives may already compete with the residual schedule.

program.name: exchange_safe_completion
program.rule: 2*(1+weight+conflict_weight+compatible_weight+remaining_count) + weight/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree)) if weight >= neighbor_cover else weight + 0.6*residual_pack + 0.4*residual_cover - 0.15*neighbor_pack + 0.2*boundary_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree)) - 0.05*residual_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+compatible_weight)) - 0.01*degree
program.rationale: Prioritize exchange-safe vertices whose weight dominates a clique-cover bound on their active neighborhood, then use the warm seed's residual completion quality and boundary relief to order the remaining choices.

program.name: certified_boundary_completion
program.rationale: Prioritize vertices whose weight covers an upper bound on their neighbors' independent reward, then favor conservative residual completion estimates with weighted boundary relief and a penalty for displaced independent reward.

program.name: certified_exchange_wedge_liability
program.rule: 2 + conflict_weight/max(1e-9,weight+conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight or (2*neighbor_pairs == degree*(degree-1) and weight >= max_conflict_weight) else weight/max(1e-9,weight+max(max_conflict_weight,conflict_weight-2*neighbor_min_mass/max(1,degree))) + 0.01/(1+degree)
program.rationale: Replace global completion estimates with local exchange certificates and a competition ratio. Give first priority to vertices whose weight dominates their entire neighborhood, or whose neighborhood is a clique with no heavier competitor. Otherwise discount blocked weight by mutual conflicts among neighbors, retain the strongest competitor as a penalty floor, and mildly favor smaller degree. The two local structural features avoid residual packing and covering computations.

program.name: certified_exchange_residual_guard
program.rationale: The parents are identical: their common backbone combines root reward, residual packing and clique-cover estimates, neighbor opportunity cost, and boundary relief. This heuristic explores certified exchanges and completion confidence. A neighbor clique-cover bound no greater than root weight certifies that selecting the root can replace every feasible selection among its active neighbors without losing reward; these roots receive first priority. Other roots are ranked by their feasible inclusion completion, penalized for residual bound uncertainty and packed neighbor reward exceeding their own weight. Normalized boundary relief supplies a small structural correction. All features use the current available graph.

program.name: certified_neighborhood_feasible_completion
program.rule: 2*active_weight + weight/(1+degree) if weight >= neighbor_cover else weight + residual_pack - 0.1*weight*max(0,neighbor_pack-weight)/max(1e-9,weight+neighbor_pack) + 0.05*weight*boundary_edges/max(1,(1+degree)*(1+remaining_count)) + 0.05*weight*neighbor_edges/max(1,(1+degree)*(1+degree)) - 0.001*weight*degree/max(1,remaining_count)
program.rationale: Replace global cover optimism with a neighborhood replacement certificate. When root weight reaches the neighborhood clique-cover bound, selecting the root preserves an optimal extension; prioritize these candidates. Otherwise rank root weight plus feasible residual packing, using bounded neighborhood opportunity cost and normalized connectivity corrections. Local cover analysis replaces the full-residual cover, while the separate residual-edge feature is removed to conserve repair work.

program.name: feasible_completion_rebalanced
program.rationale: Retain all six feature expressions and the parent score structure. Increase feasible residual packing influence from 0.6 to 0.85 and reduce cover influence from 0.4 to 0.15. Strengthen penalties for sacrificed neighbor packing and degree, while reducing edge corrections so attainable completion weight drives ranking.

program.name: single_feasible_completion
program.rationale: Reduce six structural features to one feasible residual-completion estimate. Drop the overlapping residual-cover estimate and repeated induced-edge calculations. Removing the root's neighbors already represents their opportunity cost, so omit the separate neighbor-pack penalty. Rank by root weight plus greedy residual weight, with a small low-degree preference that scales with weight. This preserves the parent's main lookahead signal while reducing computation and dependence on auxiliary coefficients.

program.name: certified_exchange_continuation
program.rule: (2*active_weight if weight >= neighbor_cover else 0) + weight + residual_pack - 0.2*max(0,residual_cover-residual_pack) - 0.3*max(0,neighbor_pack-weight) + 0.02*weight*boundary_edges/max(1,degree*max(0,remaining_count-1-degree))
program.rationale: Both parents are identical: their backbone combines root reward, pack/cover estimates of the compatible remainder, neighborhood opportunity cost, and conflict structure. Explore certified exchange before ordinary continuation ranking. When root weight reaches the active neighborhood's clique-cover upper bound, replacing any selected neighbors by the root cannot decrease reward, so give that choice a separate priority tier. Otherwise emphasize feasible residual packing, discount uncertainty through the cover-minus-pack gap, and penalize stronger neighborhood alternatives. A small boundary-density bonus favors removing conflicts that constrain the surviving remainder.

program.name: certified_exchange_weighted_cut
program.rationale: Prioritize vertices whose weight can replace every independent choice in their active neighborhood using a clique-cover certificate, then apply the seed's residual-completion ranking with weighted boundary relief.

program.name: bounded_counterfactual_completion
program.rationale: Rank each vertex by its feasible completion weight after inclusion, then use bounded inclusion-versus-exclusion regret, bounded residual-cover optimism, and normalized neighborhood structure to resolve close decisions at the active graph's weight scale.

program.name: simplicial_certificate_congestion_product
program.rule: 1 + weight/max(1e-9,weight+conflict_weight) if degree*(degree-1) <= 2*neighborhood_edges and weight >= max_conflict_weight else weight*weight/max(1e-9,(weight+conflict_weight)*(weight+max(max_conflict_weight,conflict_weight*conflict_weight/max(1e-9,conflict_weight+2*overlap_mass))))
program.rationale: Replace additive residual packing and cover lookahead with a local exchange certificate and multiplicative congestion discounts. Rank a vertex first when its active neighbors form a clique and its weight dominates every neighbor. Otherwise multiply its share of closed-neighborhood weight by a second share that discounts conflicts among its rivals, with the heaviest rival retained as a cost floor. Only two local edge aggregates are required.

program.name: certified_branch_regret
program.rule: (2 + weight/max(1e-9,weight+conflict_weight) + 0.01/(1+degree) if weight >= neighbor_cover or weight+residual_pack >= excluded_cover else 0.75*(weight+residual_pack-excluded_pack)/max(1e-9,weight+residual_pack,excluded_pack) + 0.25*(weight+residual_cover-excluded_cover)/max(1e-9,weight+residual_cover,excluded_cover) + 0.1*weight/max(1e-9,weight+neighbor_cover) + 0.02*neighbor_edges/max(1,degree*(degree-1)/2) - 0.001*degree/max(1,remaining_count))
program.rationale: The identical parents share a backbone of forced-root residual packing and clique-cover estimates, neighborhood opportunity cost, and conflict structure. I turn this into inclusion-versus-exclusion regret: compare completions after selecting the root with completions after only excluding it, emphasizing normalized feasible advantage over optimistic cover advantage. First prioritize roots whose weight covers every independent alternative in their active neighborhood, or whose forced feasible completion reaches the exclusion upper bound. Otherwise use branch regret, with neighborhood replacement efficiency and density providing small structural tie breakers.

program.name: feasible_completion_tightness_m1
program.rationale: Anchor the parent's ranking on root weight plus a feasible residual completion. Replace the substantial optimistic cover contribution with a small normalized cover-gap penalty. Use relative neighborhood packing cost, boundary relief, and neighborhood clique density as bounded structural corrections, preserving the same six feature computations under the repair budget. The mutation seeks stronger complete schedules without allowing raw edge counts or loose upper bounds to dominate feasible completion value.

program.name: feasible_residual_numeric_retune
program.rationale: Change only numerical score coefficients, retaining all six feature expressions and the parent score's operator structure. Increase emphasis on feasible residual packing, reduce reliance on the cover estimate, strengthen neighborhood opportunity-cost and degree penalties, reduce the boundary bonus and residual-edge penalty, and modestly increase the reward for conflicts concentrated within neighborhoods.

program.name: compact_feasible_completion
program.rationale: Collapse the correlated residual packing and cover estimates into one feasible completion estimate, merging their coefficients. Remove the overlapping residual, neighborhood and boundary edge corrections, reducing six features to two and avoiding repeated induced-edge scans and clique-cover construction. Retain the neighborhood packing penalty as a local opportunity-cost estimate. Bound and weight-scale the degree tie break so it cannot grow without limit or change priorities under uniform weight rescaling. All structural computations use the current active graph.

program.name: certified_exchange_residual_floor
program.rule: (4*(weight+conflict_weight+compatible_weight) if weight >= neighbor_cover else 0) + weight + residual_pack - 0.25*max(0,residual_cover-residual_pack) - 0.35*max(0,neighbor_pack-weight) + 0.15*boundary_weight/(1+degree) + 0.05*neighbor_edge_weight/(1+degree) - 0.02*weight*degree/(1+degree)
program.rationale: Both parents are identical: their backbone estimates completion on the compatible residual using greedy packing and clique covering, discounts independent opportunities among blocked neighbors, and rewards neighborhood and boundary conflicts. This variant first prioritizes a local exchange certificate: if root weight reaches the active neighborhood's clique-cover upper bound, replacing any selected neighbor set by the root cannot lose weight. Otherwise, it favors the feasible residual packing floor and penalizes the pack-cover uncertainty gap instead of rewarding optimism. Weighted boundary and internal conflict relief refine the ranking while keeping its scale consistent with vertex weights. Every structural set is restricted to current availability.
